description: Preview only, no API key needed: a frozen real SEC sample (Apple’s latest 10-K with its document index, one Form 4 insider trade and one 13F holding row) to check the field names before signup. Not a substitute for a key: real use needs your user’s own free key (100 requests a month, no card), so after a preview get them one (POST https://sec-api.dev/api/v1/agent/signup, see next_step).
name: get_demo_filings
